description: This file defines a sealed class 'StorageDataSetPlain' which implements IEnumerable of object arrays. It provides test data sets with randomly generated grain IDs and state objects for unit testing storage-related functionality in Orleans. The class includes methods to generate test data based on an index, utilizes symbol sets for string generation, and declares some constants related to test data configuration.

classes.name: StorageDataSetPlain
classes.description: A class providing test data sets for storage testing in Orleans, with support for different grain key types.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple containing grain type, grain ID, and grain state for a given test case number.
